name: seed-guard
description: Blocks database seed, reset and drop commands unless DATABASE_URL points at your own machine.

allowHosts.title: Allowed hosts
allowHosts.description: Comma-separated database hosts that count as your own machine, besides localhost, 127.0.0.1 and ::1 (docker-compose service names, * wildcards allowed).

denyUnknown.title: Deny unknown target
denyUnknown.description: Also block when no DATABASE_URL can be found at all (default: allow, since the tool then uses its own config).
